title: Verify an official backflow report portal before filing
description: Confirm the issuing utility, official domain, property and assembly identifiers, tester eligibility, and receipt path before entering a backflow test report.
prompt: How can the official reporting portal be verified before information is submitted?
answer: The issuing utility or authority establishes the correct portal. Confirm its official link, the property and assembly record, tester eligibility, and the accepted-submission receipt before entering data.
urgency: Do not send property or tester data to an unverified portal. Escalate rejected files or missing receipt evidence before the deadline.
identifiers: The governing utility links or names the authorized filing route.
The property, assembly, tester, and notice identifiers match the official record.
The workflow provides a receipt, accepted status, or other documented completion proof.

choices.label: I need the portal for a city or utility
choices.detail: Use the portal-family index to match BSI, WEIRS, SwiftComply, VEPO, TrackMyBackflow, Tokay, or SpryBackflow to a local workflow.

choices.label: I have an official notice
choices.detail: Match the issuer, property, assembly, and notice identifiers before filing.

choices.label: The device failed or needs service
choices.detail: Define repair, retest, and resubmission responsibility separately.

steps.title: Establish the governing record
steps.body: Start with the issuer notice or official utility website and follow its current portal link.

steps.title: Match the filing identity
steps.body: Verify the property, assembly, tester, date, result, and required notice or device identifiers.

steps.title: Prove accepted completion
steps.body: Save the receipt or accepted status and route any rejection to the party responsible for correction and resubmission.

safeChecks: Open the portal from the issuing utility or authority rather than a copied search result.
Confirm the exact property and assembly before authorizing or uploading work.
Keep the test result, submission receipt, and any correction notice together.
stopConditions: The portal is not linked or named by the issuer.
The record identifiers do not match the notice or assembly.
Submission cannot be proven after upload.
notThisDevice: A portal-family index helps discovery but does not establish the local rule.
Portal access does not prove tester eligibility.
This page does not replace the issuing authority's instructions.

related.title: Browse portal families and mapped utilities

evidenceNote: Use the governing utility or authority source to establish the authorized portal, then preserve the accepted filing evidence.
